own.notes: For integer quantity q from 1 through 1000, select the segment with the largest from value not exceeding q. Evaluate constant + linear × q + quadratic × q² in GBP pence, then round to a nonnegative integer. Coefficients use the absolute quantity, not an offset from the segment start. The inclusive ranges are 1–146, 147–731 and 732–1000. This model matches all 94 distinct observed quantities exactly. It was inferred from 14 exploratory quantities and subsequently passed 80 unchanged-model validation checks: eight transition-neighbourhood checks and 72 additional checks spread across the domain. Validation exact-match, within-1% and within-5% rates were all 100%, with maximum observed error of 0 pence. Adjacent-integer probes confirmed the transitions at 146/147 and 731/732. Both domain endpoints were observed, and consecutive sampled quantities are at most 15 apart. Confidence is high, but this is a numerical reconstruction, not source verification: 906 quantities were unqueried, so exact equality or error bounds at every unseen quantity are not established. Overall study usage across both contexts was 192 attempted requests, 13 REA operations including inspection, and four fitting calls.
